title: Lean Months
text: The biomass stores are nearly empty. {who} asks what the colony eats this week.

choices.label: Cut everyone's rations
choices.reply: Short rations for a while. Nobody likes it; nobody starves.

choices.label: Children and the sick first
choices.reply: The adults go short so the young ones don't. {who} nods and takes the news to the kitchens.

choices.label: Buy growth kits with alloys
choices.reply: The printers run emergency growth kits overnight. 150 alloys gone; the shelves fill a little.
